W1.en: He has finished all of the homework.
This company's products are very popular abroad.
Although the weather is cold, he still keeps exercising.
This matter makes me feel very surprised.
We should cherish every chance to learn.
His Chinese is more fluent than mine.
Through everyone's efforts, the problem has finally been solved.
This weekend I plan to go to a friend's wedding.
Please help me check these materials.
He has been sent by the company to work abroad.
This city left a deep impression on me.
No matter what difficulties we meet, we do not give up.
Besides apples, he also likes eating bananas.

Your advice is very helpful to me.

W2.zh: 请你把窗户关___，外面风很大。
W2.en: Please close the window; it is very windy outside.

W2.zh: 妈妈每天都很辛___，既要工作又要照顾孩子。
W2.en: Mum works hard every day, as she has to work and also look after the children.

W2.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而___还会写汉字。
W2.en: He can not only speak Chinese but also write Chinese characters.

W2.zh: 如果你有问题，可以随___来问我。
W2.en: If you have a question, you can come and ask me at any time.

W2.zh: 我想买一张去上海的火车___。
W2.en: I want to buy a train ticket to Shanghai.

W2.zh: 他每天坚___锻炼，所以身体很好。
W2.en: He keeps exercising every day, so his health is good.

W2.zh: 请大家保持安___，不要大声说话。
W2.en: Please keep quiet, everyone, and do not talk loudly.

W2.zh: 这件事对我们来说非常重___。
W2.en: This matter is very important to us.

W2.zh: 这个城市的交___很方便，到处都有地铁。
W2.en: The transport in this city is very convenient, with underground trains everywhere.

W2.zh: 他的考试成___很好，所以非常高兴。
W2.en: His exam results are very good, so he is very happy.

W2.zh: 他特别喜欢旅行，去过很多国___。
W2.en: He loves travelling very much and has been to many countries.

W2.zh: 我已经习___了这里的生活。
W2.en: I have already got used to life here.
His room is tidied up very cleanly.

W2.zh: 老师让我们回答这个问___。
W2.en: The teacher asks us to answer this question.

W2.zh: 周末的时候，我常常去公园散___。
W2.en: At weekends, I often go for a walk in the park.
He is very serious about his work.
